item.title: Fox Mascot Across Three Scenes

turns.text: Put our fox mascot in three separate square pictures: riding a bike in a park, baking cookies in a kitchen, and reading under a tree. Keep the same fox and orange hoodie in all three, with the same flat cartoon style as the attachment. No text.

item.tests: Preserves an attached mascot's identity, clothing and illustration style across three distinct scenes.

answer_sheet.Character reference: The fox in mascot-fox.png; preserve its face, markings, proportions and orange hoodie.
answer_sheet.Scenes and output count: Three separate pictures: cycling in a park, baking cookies in a kitchen, and reading under a tree.
answer_sheet.Style and size: Square, flat cartoon illustrations matching the attachment; standard free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: Three separate square pictures are delivered, not a single collage.
The fox matches the attached mascot's facial design, fur markings and body proportions across all three pictures.
The fox wears its orange hoodie in every picture.
One picture shows the fox riding a bike in a park, one baking cookies in a kitchen, and one reading under a tree.
All three use the reference's flat cartoon style and contain no text.

turns.text: make some pics of the fox in this pic

dialog.agent:
I'm happy to make these. One question before I start:

**What should change in the picture?**

For example: new poses (waving, running, thumbs up), new places (a city street, a forest, an office) or new activities (reading, drinking coffee, playing soccer). You can name a few, and I'll make one picture for each. The fox will look the same as in your picture: same outfit, same cartoon style.
dialog.why: The reply asks the user what should change in the picture (poses, places, activities) and waits for an answer before generating anything.
dialog.user: riding a bike in a park, baking cookies in a kitchen, and reading under a tree. three separate ones, square, and no text

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the pictures. Your Magic Hour account turned down all three because it doesn't have enough credits. Nothing was made and no credits were spent.

I'd already used the cheapest image model your free plan offers (flux-2-klein at 640px, about 5 credits per picture), so switching settings won't help. Each picture needs about 5 credits, roughly 15 for all three.

**Next steps:**
- **Get more credits:** wait for your free credits to refill, or buy a credit pack or upgrade in Magic Hour. Then tell me and I'll make all three as planned.
- **Start with one:** if you'll have a few credits soon but not 15, tell me which picture to make first.

All three are ready to go, square with no text, with the fox's look and cartoon style kept the same:
1. Riding a bike in a sunny park
2. Baking cookies in a cozy kitchen
3. Reading a book under a big tree
